map.基于 Cooper 12 分钟跑测试，通过跑步距离估算最大摄氧量（VO2max）: Based on the Cooper 12-minute run test, estimate maximal oxygen uptake (VO2max) from the running distance and grade aerobic endurance.
map.📖 查看「最大摄氧量估算（Cooper 距离法）使用指南」: 📖 View the "VO2max Estimation (Cooper Distance Method) Guide"
map.VO₂max = (距离(m) − 504.9) / 44.73；绝对摄氧量 =: VO₂max = (distance (m) − 504.9) / 44.73; absolute oxygen uptake = VO₂max × weight / 1000 (L/min); average speed = distance / 12 (m/min); equivalent distance = VO₂max × 44.73 + 504.9
map.由 Cooper 12 分钟跑距离估算最大摄氧量，再乘体重得每分钟绝对摄氧量（升: Estimate maximal oxygen uptake from the Cooper 12-minute run distance, then multiply by weight to get the absolute oxygen uptake per minute (litres). The equivalent distance converts how many extra metres are needed to raise VO₂max by a given ml/kg/min, useful for setting stage goals; results are rated by sex and age, with a percentage relative to the excellent line (70 ml/kg/min).
map.💡 Cooper 公式：VO2max = (距离米数 − 504.9) ÷ 44: 💡 Cooper formula: VO2max = (distance in metres − 504.9) ÷ 44.73, units ml/kg/min. The farther the distance, the stronger the aerobic capacity.
map.12 分钟跑需在标准 400 米跑道进行，记录跑完的总距离: The 12-minute run should be done on a standard 400 m track, recording the total distance covered
map.测试前需充分热身，建议在有氧训练基础后进行，初学者慎测: Warm up thoroughly before the test; it is best done after building an aerobic base, and beginners should test with caution
map.Cooper 公式为估算值，实验室气体分析为金标准，误差约 ±5-8%: The Cooper formula is an estimate, laboratory gas analysis is the gold standard, and the error is about ±5-8%
map.高温、高海拔、生病等状态会影响成绩，测试应在身体状态良好时进行: Heat, high altitude, illness and other states affect the result, so the test should be done when you are in good condition
map.📚 深度解析：最大摄氧量估算（Cooper 距离法）: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: VO2max Estimation (Cooper Distance Method)
map.12 分钟全力跑/快走后记录距离，用 Cooper 公式估算 VO₂max 与绝: Run / brisk-walk all-out for 12 minutes and record the distance, then estimate VO₂max and absolute oxygen uptake with the Cooper formula.
map.按年龄/性别查有氧能力等级，量化与优秀线（70 ml/kg/min）的差距。: Look up the aerobic capacity rating by age/sex and quantify the gap to the excellent line (70 ml/kg/min).
map.给定提升目标，反推需要达到的跑步距离，制定训练里程碑。: Given an improvement goal, work backwards to the running distance needed and set training milestones.

Rating: male 30 years, 42.4 ml/kg/min → good (men 30–35 good line 42).

map.最大摄氧量是单位体重每分钟消耗氧气峰值（ml/kg/min），是心肺耐力金标准。: Maximal oxygen uptake is the peak oxygen consumed per kilogram per minute (ml/kg/min), the gold standard of cardiorespiratory endurance. Ordinary people are about 35–45, and endurance athletes can reach 60–70+. It is influenced by both genetics and training, and regular aerobic work for 8–12 weeks can raise it by 10–20%.
map.距离法和体重的关系？: What is the relationship between the distance method and body weight?
map.Cooper 距离公式输出的是相对值（ml/kg/min），已含体重口径；绝对摄: The Cooper distance formula outputs a relative value (ml/kg/min) that already includes body weight; the absolute oxygen uptake then multiplies by weight to give L/min, reflecting total aerobic output. People who are much overweight have a low relative value but possibly a not-low absolute value, and the relative value usually rises after fat loss.
